about: Every string the WRF/ArWen column card (guided) and the From a WRF or ArWen run tab (advanced) show. Plain words in text; a CM1 or WRF name only in hint. {name} fields are filled with the file's own numbers.

card.title.text: Use a sounding from my WRF or ArWen run

card.line.text: Pick a time and a place in your own run. GM1 takes the air above that spot and grows an idealized storm in it.

file.help.text: A path on the computer running GM1. WRF and ArWen histories both work, in any netCDF format.

file.found.text: Files found in your runs folder:

file.none_found.text: No history files in your runs folder. Type the full path instead.

map.label.text: Click the map to pick the spot

map.cape_note.text: Instability takes a few seconds: GM1 works it out on a sample of columns.

map.help.text: Brighter means more wind shear (or more instability). Storms that rotate need both.

point.chosen.text: Grid column {i}, {j}: {lat}, {lon}, {distance} from the spot you picked.

point.no_map.text: This run has no map (an idealized run), so pick the spot on the picture or type its column and row, counted from 1 at the south-west corner.

numbers.srh.text: Spin available to a storm, lowest 3 km

numbers.hydro.text: CM1 rebuilds your run's pressure from this file to within {hpa} hPa.

expect.weak.text: Little instability here: expect small showers or no storm at all.

expect.pulse.text: Unstable air but weak shear: expect short-lived storms that rain out where they form.

expect.multicell.text: Unstable air and moderate shear: expect clusters of storms that renew themselves.

expect.supercell.text: Unstable air and strong shear: rotating storms are possible.

expect.note.text: A rough guide from two numbers, not a forecast.

coverage.text.text: This uses one column of your run as the environment: the same air everywhere in the domain, flat ground, and no weather coming in from the sides. For a GM1 domain driven by your whole run, use Downscale a WRF or ArWen run (3D) in Advanced.

use.next.text: Next: how long can it run?

use.keeping.text: Keeping the column for your storm...

use.too_low.text: The air in your run's column stops {top} km up, below the top of this storm's model.

use.too_low_fix.text: Use a run whose model reaches higher, or Advanced, New run, From a WRF or ArWen run, with your own namelist and a lower top.

use.waiting.text: The storm for your own air comes with the new starter storms; until then use Advanced, New run, From a WRF or ArWen run.

tab.title.text: From a WRF or ArWen run

tab.lead.text: One column of your WRF or ArWen run becomes the sounding of a CM1 run: the importer writes it and sets the namelist to read it.

tab.namelist_help.text: The importer sets the namelist to read the new sounding; the change shows in the diff.

tab.follow.text: Move the domain with the storm
tab.follow.hint: --wrf-frame follow: umove, vmove and the bubble centre

tab.follow_help.text: A storm in new air moves differently from the one the namelist was set up for. GM1 predicts its path from the column's winds and moves the domain and the starting bubble so it stays inside; the change shows in the diff.

tab.frame_note.text: Unticked, the namelist's own frame and bubble are kept; if Check says the storm would leave, tick it or use the recommended frame on Domain and time.

error.pick_file.text: Type the path of a history file first.

error.pick_point.text: Pick a spot on the map first.

error.pick_column.text: Type the column and row as whole numbers from 1, or click the picture.
